memories.content: The council is aware that a short-term-rental ordinance requires a second reading before adoption. The council has a scheduled August recess starting August 15, 2026. The council's agenda for the remaining meetings before recess is not yet finalized; members have varying opinions on the ordinance.

The Riverton city council has a short-term-rental ordinance that has passed a first reading. A second reading is required for adoption. The council's next regular meeting is on July 29, 2026, and there may be a special meeting before the August recess begins on August 15, 2026. The council can schedule the second reading at any regular or special meeting before the recess.
